assets.caption: Table A-5 Temperature Conversion Chart, Centigrade-Fahrenheit
assets.notes: Very large multi-column temperature conversion table (~58 data rows, 10 columns = 5 paired Centigrade/Fahrenheit groups). The OCR Markdown transcription contains severe column-alignment errors, garbled numeric values, and inconsistent row widths throughout — making deterministic cell-level transcription infeasible from either the raster image or the OCR output alone. Dedicated tabular extraction is required to produce a trustworthy table_data block.

issues.detail: Table A-5 is a large 10-column (~58-row) temperature conversion table. The OCR Markdown source shows extensive column misalignment and garbled numeric values across most rows (e.g. rows with 14+ pipe-separated tokens instead of 10, impossible temperature values, duplicated reference numbers). Safe cell-level transcription with pdf2md-table/v1 schema conformance cannot be performed reliably; needs_extraction set to true. A dedicated PDF table extractor (e.g. Camelot or Tabula) operating on the original PDF at this page is recommended.
